items.text_th: ไอดีหาย!! ไม่ต้องตกใจผมมีวิธี เวอร์ชั่นที่คุณเห็นอยู่นี้คือ เวอร์ชั่น VNG ซึ่งไม่ใช่เวอร์ชั่นก่อนหน้านี้ที่มีให้เราโหลดเล่นในสโตร์ เวอร์ชั่นที่เราเล่นกันก่อนหน้านี้คือ เวอร์ชั่น global ซึ่งคุณอาจจะต้องไปโหลดไฟล์ APK จากนอกสโตร์
items.text_vn: Mất ID!! Đừng hoảng, mình có cách. Phiên bản bạn đang thấy đây là bản VNG, không phải bản trước đây có trên store cho mình tải về chơi. Bản mà mọi người chơi trước đây là bản global, có thể bạn sẽ phải tải file APK từ ngoài store.
items.summary_vn: Hướng dẫn: bản VNG khác bản global, muốn chơi ID cũ phải tải APK.
items.text_en: Lost your ID!! Don't panic, I have a fix. The version you're seeing here is the VNG version, not the one that used to be on the store for us to download. The version everyone played before is the global version, so you might have to download an APK file from outside the store.
items.summary_en: Guide: VNG version differs from global; to play your old ID you need the APK.
